design_system.visual_anchor: Flat, borderline-utilitarian mobile-first field UI built on the slate palette with no shadows or gradients, high-contrast semantic status colors (green/amber), blue-700 accent for all interactive affordances, and monospace data tags for activity codes.
design_system.do_not_do: No drop shadows, no gradients, no rounded-full pill buttons, no Title Case labels (sentence case + uppercase section heads only), no font-weight above 500, no custom colors outside the defined token set.

typography.mono_font: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace  (CSS var --font-mono — used only for activity code chips)
typography.weight_scale: 400 (regular — body text, descriptions) and 500 (medium — headings, labels, stat values, button text). No 600/700/bold found or allowed.

size_scale.used_for: section headings (uppercase tracking-wide), sub-labels (trade group, date), chip descriptions, stepper labels
body instructions, time values, inline action text ('Tap to mark in'), empty-state messages, stat card labels
page titles in step headers (h1), body default (root font-size)
stat card large numeric values only

surface_tokens.used_for: card/row background, header background, bottom bar background, default stat card
avatar circle background, disabled button fill, in-time read-only chip background
selected checkbox row background, text button hover
checked-in row background, success stat card background, submitted banner
warning row background (no check-in), warning stat card background

text_tokens.used_for: primary text — employee names, page titles, stat values. NOTE: reconciled — both map to --color-neutral (#1e293b). Use text-slate-800 as the canonical primary text color; text-slate-900 reserved for large stat values only.
secondary text — avatar initials, body instructions, completed-step labels
muted text — section heading labels, trade group, stat card labels, bottom nav inactive
placeholder/empty-state text, loading indicator, upcoming stepper text, icon tint, time arrow
arrow separator between in/out time only

semantic_success.text: text-green-700 (#15803d) for values, text-green-800 (#166534) for banner body, text-green-600 (#16a34a / var(--color-success)) for icons
semantic_success.used_for: checked-in state rows, 'X applied' badge, submitted-day banner, success stat cards, submit-complete button fill (bg-green-600)

semantic_warning.text: text-amber-700 (#b45309) for body, text-amber-800 (#92400e) for stat value, text-amber-500 (#f59e0b) for warning icon
semantic_warning.used_for: no-check-in warning rows, pending stat card, missing-data alerts

accent.active_press: bg-blue-800 (#1e40af) — active: state on primary buttons
accent.submitting: bg-blue-400 (#60a5fa) — used only for submitting/loading button state
accent.text: text-blue-700 (#1d4ed8) — inline action labels ('Tap to mark in', 'Select all'), selected chip text, stepper current-step label, live-hours display
accent.focus_ring: ring-blue-600 (#2563eb) — all focus-visible rings consistently use blue-600
accent.light_surface: bg-blue-50 (#eff6ff) — hover on unselected chips, selected checkbox row
accent.light_border: border-blue-200 (#bfdbfe) — selected checkbox row border, hover:border-blue-300 on chips
accent.overuse_check: Accent blue is NOT used for body text, headings, or decorative elements — it is strictly limited to interactive affordances (buttons, selected states, focus rings, inline action text). This is correct.

border_radius.rounded-lg: 8px — cards, rows, buttons, inputs, banners (the dominant radius)
border_radius.rounded-full: 9999px — avatar circles, 'X applied' pill badge only

button_style.primary: bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg, min-h-[52px] or min-h-[56px] (RECONCILED: canonical is min-h-[52px]; dashboard CTA was 56px — normalize to 52px for consistency), full-width, active:bg-blue-800, focus-visible ring-2 ring-blue-600 ring-offset-2, transition-colors. Labels are sentence case.
button_style.primary_disabled: bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed (same shape, muted fill)
button_style.secondary: border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg bg-transparent, min-h-[48px], hover:bg-slate-50 active:bg-slate-100. Used for 'Back' buttons.
button_style.dark_secondary: bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium rounded-lg, min-h-[48px], hover:bg-slate-700 active:bg-slate-900. Used for 'Next: checkout' alongside a secondary 'Back'.
button_style.text_button: text-blue-700 font-medium text-sm, no border, px-2 py-1 rounded, hover:bg-blue-50 active:bg-blue-100. Used for 'Select all / Deselect all'.
button_style.icon_button: w-9 h-9 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center, text-slate-600, hover:bg-slate-100 active:bg-slate-200. Used for back arrow.

input_style.text_number: w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-800, font-medium text-lg tabular-nums, min-h-[52px], focus:ring-2 ring-blue-600 border-transparent. Placeholder: text-slate-400 font-normal text-base.
input_style.time: Inline within a container div (border border-slate-200 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5), bg-transparent, text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 tabular-nums, min-h-[32px], no visible border on the input itself.
input_style.checkbox: w-5 h-5 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-700 accent-blue-700, embedded in a full-row tappable label.

card_style.stat_card: rounded-lg border p-4 min-h-[88px] flex flex-col gap-2. Default: bg-white border-slate-200. Semantic variants swap bg and border to green-50/green-200 or amber-50/amber-200. No shadow.
card_style.employee_row: rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3, flex items-center gap-3. Avatar initial (w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-100), name (font-medium text-slate-800), sub-text (text-xs text-slate-500 truncate). No shadow.
card_style.status_row_success: Same shape as employee_row but bg-green-50 border-green-200, with CheckCircle2 icon (text-green-600) replacing avatar.
card_style.status_row_warning: Same shape but bg-amber-50 border-amber-200, with AlertTriangle icon (text-amber-500) replacing avatar.

chip_style.activity_chip: rounded-md border px-3 py-2 min-h-[44px] flex-shrink-0, two-line content: code in font-mono text-sm font-medium, description in text-xs. Unselected: bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700, hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50. Selected: bg-blue-700 border-blue-700 text-white, description text-blue-100. Horizontally scrollable row with snap-x.
chip_style.status_badge: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Success: text-green-700 bg-green-50 border border-green-200. Used for 'X applied' count.

spacing_scale.used_for: mt-0.5 on chip descriptions, warning sub-text
mb-1 on date label above greeting
gap-1.5 between label + value in time chips
space-y-2 for list gaps (employee rows), gap-2 for stat grid, flex gap-2 for button pairs, pb-2 on chip scroller, mb-2 on checkout row inner spacing
px-2.5 py-1.5 on inline time chips
gap-3 for stat grid, gap-3 inside rows (icon-to-text), mb-3 under section headings, space-y-3 on some body lists, py-3 for bottom bar and row vertical padding
px-4 horizontal page padding (canonical), p-4 for stat cards, py-4 for header bottom padding, mb-4 between title+stepper, py-4 for primary buttons
py-5 / space-y-5 for main content area vertical rhythm, pt-5 for step-page headers
pt-6 on dashboard header, pb-24 for body bottom clearance
py-8 for empty-state vertical padding, pb-32 on check-in page body
pb-36 for body bottom clearance on pages with two-row bottom bars

layout_patterns.page_shell: flex flex-col min-h-screen bg-slate-50 — every page uses this identical wrapper
layout_patterns.header: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-4 — contains title + optional stepper. RECONCILED: dashboard uses pt-6 pb-4, step pages use pt-5 pb-4 — canonical is pt-5 pb-4 for step pages, pt-6 pb-4 for dashboard (intentional: dashboard has more prominent greeting).
layout_patterns.scrollable_body: flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-5 — always with enough pb-XX to clear the fixed bottom bar
layout_patterns.fixed_bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 — contains primary CTA(s)
layout_patterns.bottom_nav: Same positioning but with flex tab buttons, active tab gets text-blue-700 border-t-2 border-blue-700

inconsistencies_reconciled.issue: Primary button min-height: dashboard CTA uses min-h-[56px], check-in and activity pages use min-h-[52px]
inconsistencies_reconciled.resolution: Canonical primary button height is min-h-[52px]. Dashboard CTA should be updated to match. The 56px was an early outlier.

inconsistencies_reconciled.issue: Primary text color flip: stat card uses text-slate-900 for large values, all other primary text uses text-slate-800
inconsistencies_reconciled.resolution: text-slate-800 is the canonical primary text color (matches --color-neutral #1e293b). text-slate-900 is allowed ONLY for text-3xl stat values (intentional emphasis on large numbers). Everywhere else, use text-slate-800.

inconsistencies_reconciled.issue: Dashboard header uses pt-6, step-page headers use pt-5
inconsistencies_reconciled.resolution: Intentional: dashboard has a more prominent greeting with date above. Canonicalized as: dashboard header pt-6, step-page headers pt-5.

inconsistencies_reconciled.issue: Bottom clearance padding varies: pb-24 (dashboard), pb-32 (check-in), pb-36 (activity, checkout)
inconsistencies_reconciled.resolution: Varies by bottom-bar height: single-button bar → pb-24, bar with summary line + button → pb-32, bar with two rows of buttons → pb-36. This is intentional and correct — each value must match its bottom bar height + 16px breathing room.

design_system.master_instruction: Build every new screen using the flat, shadow-free, border-outlined component style on a bg-slate-50 page shell with bg-white cards. Use only the slate palette for neutrals (50/100/200/300/400/500/600/700/800/900), blue-700 as the sole interactive accent, green-50→700 for success states, and amber-50→700 for warnings. Limit font-weight to 400 and 500 (Inter), use font-mono only for activity/equipment codes, and keep all labels in sentence case or uppercase-xs section headings — never Title Case. Every interactive element must have min-h-[44px]+, focus-visible:ring-2 ring-blue-600, and transition-colors; every new color, spacing, or radius value not already in design-system.json must be treated as a bug.
